question: As of September 2024, Brig. (Dr.) BD Mishra (Retd.) is the Lieutenant Governor of which of the following union territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Brig. (Dr.) BD Mishra (Retd.) was appointed as the **Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh** in February 2023.
 
• The Lieutenant Governor (LG) is the **administrative head** of the Union Territory (UT) and represents the President of India in the region.
 
• BD Mishra succeeded Radha Krishna Mathur as the LG of Ladakh, becoming the **second person to hold the position** since Ladakh became a Union Territory in October 2019.
 
• Prior to this role, BD Mishra served as the **Governor of Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• The appointment of BD Mishra as LG is significant in the context of Ladakh's strategic importance and developmental priorities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union Territory of Ladakh:**

 
 
• Ladakh became a Union Territory on **31 October 2019**, following the bifurcation of Jammu & Kashmir under the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019.
 
• It consists of two districts: **Leh and Kargil**.
 
• The UT does not have a legislative assembly and is directly governed by the Lieutenant Governor and the central government.
 
 
 
• **Role of Lieutenant Governor:**
 
 
• The Lieutenant Governor acts as the **representative of the President of India** in Union Territories without a legislature.
 
• The LG has administrative, executive, and ceremonial responsibilities, particularly in regions with unique governance structures like Ladakh.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of Ladakh:**
 
 
• Ladakh shares borders with China (Tibet Autonomous Region) and Pakistan (Gilgit-Baltistan).
 
• It holds significant importance in terms of **national security** and geopolitics, particularly due to the ongoing India-China border disputes.
 
 
 
• **Developmental Challenges in Ladakh:**
 
 
• Ladakh faces unique challenges such as **harsh climatic conditions, limited infrastructure, and ecological sensitivity**.
 
• The Indian government has been focusing on improving connectivity, tourism, and sustainable development in the region.
